bio.text: Caitlin Rourk is the Democratic candidate for Texas's 10th Congressional District; The Texan reported she won the March 2026 primary outright with 60.84 percent of the vote.
She is an Army veteran who has worked in policy in Washington, D.C., according to KBTX.
According to her campaign website, she is an Army veteran and mother whose career has been in the military, business and policy.

sources.title: Chris Gober wins GOP Primary for Congressman Michael McCaul's Seat | 2026 | The Texan
Democrat Caitlin Rourk seeks U.S. House District 10 seat
